item.title: MBBS, BDS admission test on Friday
item.description: The admission test for MBBS and BDS courses for the 2025-26 academic year will be held on Friday at 10:00 am at 17 centres and 49 venues nationwide.Candidates must enter the exam hall between 8:00 am and 9:30 am.Entry will not be allowed after 9:30 am. Examinees are required to bring their admit card, HSC/equivalent admit card or registration card, and a transparent black-ink ballpoint pen, all kept inside a transparent bag. item.title: CA congratulates youth hockey team on lifting Challenger title
item.description: Chief Adviser Prof Muhammad Yunus has congratulated the Bangladesh youth hockey team after lifting the Challenger division of the Youth Hockey World Cup, calling it a source of pride for the nation.In a congratulatory message on Thursday, Prof Yunus said the players' success had uplifted the country and reflected their hard work, discipline, team unity and indomitable spirit.He noted that the team's performance had further strengthened Bangladesh's presence on the international sporting stage.Th

item.title: 7 killed as Russian military cargo plane crashes near Moscow
item.description: A Russian military cargo aircraft crashed near the city of Ivanovo, close to Moscow, on Tuesday, killing all seven people on board, including the pilot.According to the Russian Ministry of Defence, the aircraft was an AN-22 military transport plane typically used for carrying cargo.
